verdict.rationale: Finix documents webhooks that notify external systems when events occur (docs-19, docs-28, docs-29, docs-34), but this only pushes raw event data to a developer's own system — there's no evidence of a built-in rules/automation engine where a user defines conditional triggers and actions to run automatically. Building actual automation logic would require the user to write their own webhook-consuming service, which is not the same as Finix natively supporting rule-based automation.
